def feats(path):
    a=np.array(Image.open(path).convert('RGB')).astype(int)

    R,G,B=a[:,:,0],a[:,:,1],a[:,:,2]

    ma=act.copy(); ma[:, lw:]=False
    ys,xs=np.where(ma)
    if len(xs): out['activeItem_yFrac']=(round(ys.min()/H,4), round(ys.max()/H,4))
    # --- figure: pure white block in right 55%

    # keep only large runs: require column/row coverage
